sections.text: Disassembly of the Emergency Thrust Bearing for Replacement

items: Measure alignment and record it

Remove constant level oilier (251) from 
 thrust and bearing hosing (134)
Drain oil from housing.
Dismantle cap screws on each end cover
Dismantle thrust bearing end cover (109).
Dismantle snap ring (361).
Dismantle bearing cap (111).

Rotate bearing hosing (134) 1805,

sections.text: Assembly of the Emergency Thrust Bearing Replacement

items:
Clean all contact surfaces before 
 mounting.

Wipe a small amount of grease on the oil 
 seal lips in bearing housing.

Place thrust bearing housing (134) on 
 shaft, with the double locks up and slides it a long to approximately its 
 correct location.

Align locks on bearing end cover (109) 
 with the grooves in lower half-casing and rotate bearing end Cover (180) so 
 that the locks are at the bottom.

Slid thrust bearing collar (237) over 
 shaft end and Push shaft shoulder.

Apply a film of oil to the bearing seat 
 on the shaft.

Install the thrust bearing (112) on the 
 shaft (the bearing will be installed back to back)

Place snap ring (361) on the shaft 
 groove.

Screw bolt bearing end cover (109) to 
 bearing housing

Assemble bearing cap (111) being sure 
 that the prick punch marks on the cap and the casing are on the same side.
Tighten the nuts evenly.
Check thrust bearing endplay.
Refill with oil in constant level oilier.

Check the alignment of coupling between 
 driver and pump.

 the pump has been started to operate at its full speed.

 vibration during operation.

Check the oil level in the constant level 
 oilier.

Check the temperature of cooling water at 
 discharge.

 housing and thrust bearing end cover should not exceed 60

Turbines | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This documents out lines the equipment inspection procedure I1, which must be 
 performed every two years or at thrust bearing damage which comes first, as indicated by Y2 in the title block.
This pump is used to push the cooling 
 water through heat exchangers to cool the auxiliaries equipment.
The first draft Initiated by eng. Yasser soliman Rakha, tested by eng. Abed 
 Allah Ebraeihem, revised by EDEPC inspection and quality control eng Abouda Elbana, 
 accepted by general manager eng. Mohamed Hussein, and approved by eng: Fawzy 
 Sobhy Ismaiel Abu sultan power station head sector.
This document is accepted by eng. Samir 
Abd El Gilil EDEPC MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant; Mahmoud 
Mohamed Soliman; EDEPC admin and financial inspection, quality control General 
Director and supervisor of inspection and quality control head sector.
Technical Data:
Type of Pump | Double 
 Suction Centrifugal Pump
Model of Pump | 3416 
 Size 8 
 10 
 -
 17
Manufacture | Goulds Pumps
Type of Fluid | Filter water
Shaft | Horizontal
Type of Bearing | thrust (7308) and ball( 6310) bearing
Flow Rate | 2600 GPM
Discharge 
 Pressure | 6 Kg/cm
Speed | 1800 RPM
Safety Precautions
A 
 work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff should cany the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmets shoes, gloves, etc
Isolated the circuit breaker of the pump 
 motor
Disconnect electric terminals of the Pump 
 Motor.
Isolate the Pump 
 mechanically by closing suction and 
 delivery valves.
Be Sure that the pump is completely drained.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid, Filler, Feeler gauge,
Rags, Grease
Vibrometer, Dial indicator
Work to be Carried Out
Pump 
in Operation
Measure Vibration 
 level for bearing and compare it with setting values then analyze it and 
 determine what to do
Check the discharge, 
 pressure of pump and compare it with the Setting values the replace the worm 
 components
Check the temperature of bearing house 
 (60).
Pump 
out of Operation
Disassembly of the Emergency Thrust Bearing for Replacement
Measure alignment and record it
Remove constant level oilier (251) from 
 thrust and bearing hosing (134)
Drain oil from housing.
Dismantle cap screws on each end cover
Dismantle thrust bearing end cover (109).
Dismantle snap ring (361).
Dismantle bearing cap (111).
Rotate bearing hosing (134) 1805, 
 so that the two locks are on the top.
Remove thrust bearing (112) from shaft by 
 use of a bearing puller.
Slide thrust bearing collar (273).
Slide thrust bearing housing (134) from 
 shaft (122).
Inspection
Thrust bearing house, thrust bearing end 
 cover, snap ring, ball bearing collar, and end of shaft must be clean with 
 kerosene.
Inspect thrust bearing house (134) from 
 pitting, wear and corrosion
Inspect thrust bearing end cover (109) 
 from pitting, wear and corrosion.
Inspect thrust bearing cap (111) from 
 pitting, wear and corrosion.
Inspect snap ring (361) from pitting, 
 wear and corrosion
Inspect thrust bearing collar (237) from 
 pitting, wear and corrosion.
Inspect deflectors (123) from pitting, 
 wear and corrosion.
Assembly of the Emergency Thrust Bearing Replacement
Clean all contact surfaces before 
 mounting.
Wipe a small amount of grease on the oil 
 seal lips in bearing housing.
Place thrust bearing housing (134) on 
 shaft, with the double locks up and slides it a long to approximately its 
 correct location.
Align locks on bearing end cover (109) 
 with the grooves in lower half-casing and rotate bearing end Cover (180) so 
 that the locks are at the bottom.
Slid thrust bearing collar (237) over 
 shaft end and Push shaft shoulder.
Apply a film of oil to the bearing seat 
 on the shaft.
Install the thrust bearing (112) on the 
 shaft (the bearing will be installed back to back)
Place snap ring (361) on the shaft 
 groove.
Screw bolt bearing end cover (109) to 
 bearing housing
Assemble bearing cap (111) being sure 
 that the prick punch marks on the cap and the casing are on the same side.
Tighten the nuts evenly.
Check thrust bearing endplay.
Refill with oil in constant level oilier.
Check the alignment of coupling between 
 driver and pump.
Staring of Pump
Before the starting Pump, the Following Steps must be Checked:
Checked the direction of rotation of 
 pump.
Open the cooling water to each gland and 
 the quantity of water is sufficient.
Checks the level of oil in constant level 
 oilier for thrust bearing.
Priming of the pump by open suction 
 valve, close discharge valve and open vent valve until all airs expelled and 
 water flows through opening.
Open the delivery valve gradually after 
 the pump has been started to operate at its full speed.
Attendance and Checked during Operation
Check the discharge, pressure and 
 vibration during operation.
Check the oil level in the constant level 
 oilier.
Check the temperature of cooling water at 
 discharge.
Check the temperature of thrust bearing 
 housing and thrust bearing end cover should not exceed 60
